simple.meaning: צָאָה (tsâʼâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “issue , i.e. (human) excrement.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: צָאָה (H6627) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Deuteronomy 23:14, with occurrences in Deuteronomy, Ezekiel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צָאָה (H6627) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in צָאָה (H6627) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: צָאָה (tsâʼâh) / H6627 is traced through Deuteronomy 23:14, Ezekiel 4:12 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
